importantFindings.issue: Allowed Content-Language and Content-Disposition Set removes the old value but HttpRequestHeaders refuses its replacement; Applied is misleading.
importantFindings.fix: Use the public YARP RequestHeaderValueTransform, preserving stream HttpContent and native EmptyHttpContent behavior.

importantFindings.issue: Comma-separated or repeated raw preflight methods match multiple same-path derived routes and cause routing ambiguity HTTP500 before CORS validation.
importantFindings.fix: After YARP header matching, resolve only all-derived, highest-priority malformed preflight candidates so original generation IP/CORS rejects them.

importantFindings.issue: Frontend blocks an explicitly empty DenyList accepted by the specification and server.
importantFindings.fix: Require nonempty ranges only in AllowList and clarify empty DenyList semantics in the editor.
